rationale: Agent Mode Requirements give Platform 10.1.x+, Cloud Connected from app 2.1.0, the named 15 AWS service locations and enabled Model Runtime. Runtime lists additional Azure locations and global/data-zone routing qualifications that do not expand Agent Mode. Same-region assurance in About is conditional on Splunk-hosted models. Cloud Connected installation and SAIA-9918 exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6, offer 2.1.1 without Agent Mode and describe 2.4.0 as planned with fresh setup and no carried chat history. Install limits the IL2 variant to Splunk-hosted models and omits Agent Mode.

audiences: Readers assessing Agent Mode model-processing boundaries
exclusions: No customer authorization, actual tenant routing, residency guarantee, regulated approval or exact app/Platform pairing is established.

remainingConcerns: Feature-specific runtime and routing qualifications still limit broad same-region descriptions.
